verdicts.reason: A makes a reasonable left-to-right banner with a brand column, headline block and Christmas tag. However, the stars are blown up far past their original size and compete with the headline, the www.lygom.se URL is tiny, and the three groups sit at ragged, unequal baselines. B crams the 'GET A GIFT' headline against the logo/brand column with no gutter, and 'Only this Christmas' is jammed against the photo edge. Its divider lines collide with the subcopy and its oversized stars repeat A's problem, so it is clearly cramped and broken.
